verdict.rationale: Close is a CRM, so auto-enriching contact and company records is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents any firmographic or contact-data enrichment feature. The REST API, custom fields and webhooks are only developer building blocks for pushing data in from elsewhere. Chloe updating the CRM after calls is a different capability, not enrichment with firmographic data.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
